answer: Counterparty diversity stops sybil farms. Each identity must settle with 20 distinct counterparties per epoch to unlock rewards, so self-trading never qualifies. A beacon audit at dawn checks trade graphs: a reef of fake accounts sharing one hub is exposed. Forging 20 real counterparties costs 300 POA each, so 1,000 fakes cost 300,000 POA, while an honest agent pays 300 POA. Normal activity clears the bar, keeping honest rewards undiluted.
